)\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (metadata.seatNumber > 0) {\r\n            json = string(\r\n                abi.encodePacked(\r\n                    json,\r\n                    ', {\"trait_type\":  }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @dev Get all tickets for an event\r\n     */\r\n    function getEventTickets(uint256 eventId) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return
